english.name: Greek Citizenship Test (PEGP)
english.fullName: Greek naturalisation knowledge test (Πιστοποιητικό Επάρκειας Γνώσεων για Πολιτογράφηση, PEGP), thematic units, in Greek

notes: 8 tests x 20 (4/4/6/6, the official split of the thematic units) use 32/32/48/48 items; the last 16/8/8/8 of each pool (40) are training-only. Dashboard: 4 topic sets + 8 tests = 12 steps. passPct 70 (14 of 20) is Tigertest's target: the real thematic minimum is 20/40 (10 of 20 correct) inside a 70/100 overall pass that includes the Greek-language part, which is not modelled.
